headline: Argentina Faces $800 Million IMF Debt Repayment Due Today
summary: Argentina's economic team faces a maturity payment of $800 million to the IMF, with fiscal authorities holding sufficient deposits to cover the obligation.
why: Sovereign debt obligations to international lenders are critical indicators of external liquidity, reserve levels, and country risk.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Large international debt service drains central bank reserves.
